name: metron
description: Local economic policy, accounting, autonomous customer email, and invoice document operations for AI agents.

interface.longDescription: Use three skills in one plugin: enforce economic limits and accounting, autonomously manage verified customer conversations through host email tools, and generate private professional invoice PDFs from posted METRON records.
defaultPrompt: Use METRON policy, customer email, or invoice document operations.

review.commerce_description: METRON makes bounded direct Circle x402 USDC payments. A policy ALLOW automatically persists the Spend Intent as APPROVED and does not require separate human approval. ESCALATE requires explicit persisted human approval before it becomes APPROVED; DENY cannot execute or be human-overridden. Daily spend and available operating capital are absolute caps. Custom or legal commercial terms and below-minimum deals require separate persisted pre-acceptance human approval; customer acceptance always requires a distinct final human approval before invoice creation. METRON reconciles authoritative Circle evidence before accounting. EconomicRegistry is METRON's shared non-custodial provenance contract on Arc Testnet at 0x547552585d8d995c5063820b2950e0db52b4cab4 and supports multiple distinct revenue settlements per spend. Circle remains payment authority and SQLite/journals remain business truth. Registry failure never reverses reconciled payment or accounting. The email skill may autonomously contact and reply to customers through connected host tools; those communications do not approve a deal or authorize an invoice or payment. Users do not deploy or fund the shared registry. Status, service search, and estimate operations do not move funds. Testnet activity is not production settlement.
